findings.title: Open and degenerate polylines create false foundations
findings.body: Every non-empty polyline on the target layer is accepted without verifying that it is a closed rectangular foundation boundary. A single line is interpreted as a square because the fallback assigns its only edge length to both Length and Width, while other open or irregular polylines also produce arbitrary dimensions. CAD layers commonly contain construction or annotation lines, so this can create foundations where no footing boundary exists. Validate closure, minimum distinct vertices, nonzero area, and the expected rectangular geometry before emitting FoundationData.

findings.title: Nested CAD blocks lose their footprint dimensions
findings.body: A matching nested GeometryInstance is converted directly into FoundationData containing only its transform origin and rotation. Its nested geometry is never inspected, so Length and Width remain zero and the command silently places the arbitrary default foundation type. The block insertion point also need not be the center of its footprint. Recursively parse the nested instance geometry and transform the derived center and dimensions into model coordinates.

findings.title: Foundation level is selected arbitrarily
findings.body: The command uses FirstElement() from all project levels for every generated foundation. Collector order does not establish the level corresponding to the CAD geometry, so multi-level projects can receive foundations hosted on an unrelated level, with incorrect offsets or elevations. Determine the appropriate level from the CAD elevation or require the user to select one, and handle the case where no level exists.
